role: Adversarial/falsifier reviewer of the EFC corpus; tasked to refute, not confirm.
independence_caveat: Same model family as the other five reviewers; agreement is reading consistency, not independent validation.

findings.object: KC1 in EFC Gradient-Coupled Grid Action
findings.excerpt: key_results: delta_chi2=null; significance_sigma=null; datasets_used='Conceptual consistency with SPARC rotation curves (referenced; no new fit performed)'. KC1 text: 'significantly exclude the sqrt(g) form at >=5sigma'.
findings.conflict_class: epistemic overclaim: analytical kill criterion presented as if empirically established.
findings.falsified_by: An actual, pre-specified, bias-controlled comparison of linear and sqrt exponents on a defined sample with reported likelihood/delta-chi2, nuisance parameters and multiple-testing handling.

findings.excerpt: index.json lines 30-31: n(g)=1/(exp(g/a0)-1); line 38: x(g)=sqrt(beta*rho/a0). entropy_production.py line 38: n(g)=1/(exp(sqrt(g/a0))-1).
findings.conflict_class: model-internal self-contradiction or undeclared regime/variable split.
findings.falsified_by: A versioned derivation showing linear g and sqrt g apply to clearly separated regimes/observables, with an unambiguous definition of which mu links to which data analysis.

findings.excerpt: Gradient-Coupled Grid Action describes E ~ sqrt(g) when alpha*g >> kappa0 and mu(g)=1/(exp(sqrt(g/a0))-1). Grid Microphysics likewise. KC1 in 31941465 declares the linear form preferred and sqrt excluded at >=5sigma.
findings.conflict_class: physical conflict if one universal BE screening is claimed; otherwise undeclared regime/observable split.
findings.falsified_by: An explicit two-regime model with distinct validity domains, transition scales and independent observables, tested jointly without reusing parameters.

findings.excerpt: entropy_production.py line 10: 'Scenario B: correct qualitative structure, exponent 3/2 vs phenomenological 1'. Line 15: companion 31942800 'upgrades to Scenario B+'. 31942800 calls the new form 'Scenario B+'.
findings.conflict_class: provenance and labeling problem; possible post hoc maturation narrative.
findings.falsified_by: A timestamped changelog or registered scenario taxonomy showing B/B+ were defined before the form change, and an explicit derivation that B+ is a necessary consequence, not an after-the-fact repair.

findings.excerpt: entropy_production.py lines 158-159 introduce D_eff = D0*rho/(rho+rho_crit) giving Gamma ~ rho^(3/2). 31942800 replaces with D_eff ~ sqrt(rho/rho_crit) giving Gamma = Gamma0*y/(1+y). Both datasets_used=[] and significance_sigma=null.
findings.conflict_class: model selection/retrofitting: a new mode-counting assumption changes the form without empirical discrimination.
findings.falsified_by: An independent micro-derivation of D_eff from the same ground-axiomatic model, with activation rules locked in advance, uniquely giving B+ and showing B was a control model, not a data-adjusted intermediate.

findings.excerpt: 31878760 names SPARC/RAR as observational anchor but datasets_used='None (theoretical derivation)', delta_chi2=null, significance_sigma=null. 31941465 lists only 'Conceptual consistency with SPARC rotation curves'.
findings.conflict_class: missing empirical pre-testing; possible cherry-picking of the observational base.
findings.falsified_by: A preregistered RAR test on a defined SPARC-like sample comparing both functions with the same data, nuisance model and a0 treatment.

findings.excerpt: Uses Planck, BAO, Pantheon+, fsigma8 in a mu-Sigma parametrization; slip window mu~0.94, Sigma~1.05; contains no comparison of exp(g/a0) vs exp(sqrt(g/a0)).
findings.falsified_by: A full relativistic mapping from each galactic form to mu(a,k), Sigma(a,k), CMB lensing and fsigma8, then a locked likelihood comparison.

findings.object: choice of RAR/SPARC as test arena
findings.excerpt: KC1 says 'diverse systems' and >=5sigma generally, but no sample definition, estimand, fitting protocol, null model, prior, or preregistration is given.
findings.conflict_class: risk of cherry-picking and post hoc test design.
findings.falsified_by: An archived protocol dated before the model selection specifying SPARC/RAR as primary test, both competing functions, a0 prior, galaxy selection, residual criterion and significance threshold.

verdict: A -> B -> B+ cannot be defended as a pure empirical maturation chain on the basis of the raw files. KC1 is a proposed kill criterion, not an executed >=5sigma test. The sqrt form is explicitly the theoretical consequence in 31941465 and 31878760, while 31942821 holds both linear and sqrt notation. B -> B+ changes mode activation/D_eff without a reported dataset or likelihood. The most direct discriminating base is galactic RAR/rotation curves (SPARC), but it is not documented as pre-selected or actually used. CMB, lensing and fsigma8 test a different mu-Sigma parametrization and do not decide linear vs sqrt.
falsification: This adversarial reading weakens if the project can produce prior timestamped preregistration, a complete likelihood comparison on a locked galaxy sample, explicit regime mapping between the linear and sqrt exponents, and an independent micro-derivation locking B+ before data or result labeling.
